## History

Sam worked as a hired boy at 'Wayside' while [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was boarding with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. Described by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as awkward, he later made an awkward marriage proposal to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she was in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) politely rejected his offer and subsequently laughed about the incident with [Janet](../character/janet.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P20](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0020), +2 more_
